summary.text: Lisa Durnell is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 154 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Durnell is a certified residential appraiser and former Howell County deputy collector.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Durnell earned a bachelor's degree in agricultural education from the University of Missouri in 1992.
Her career experience includes working as a certified residential appraiser and as the deputy collector for Howell County.
She took office on January 8, 2025, succeeding David Paul Evans.
